pages.title: File:British Institution for Promoting the Fine Arts in the United Kingdom - founded June 4, 1805, opened January 18, 1806 (IA gri 33125008253052).pdf

ObjectName.value: British Institution for Promoting the Fine Arts in the United Kingdom : founded June 4, 1805, opened January 18, 1806

ImageDescription.value:
Copy 1 is a bound vol. containing 38 catalogs of the British Institution's annual loan exhibitions from 1813 to 1850 (not including the annual exhibition and sales catalogs of works by living British artists)
Each catalog has same title, followed by lists of governors and subscribers, a list of works exhibited, and starting in 1835 a list of contributors
Printer varies (W. Bulmer and W. Nicol, 1820-21; William Nicol, 1822-35, 1838-50; W. Clowes & Son, 1836-7)
Catalogs for 1814, 1820 and 1846 are followed by prints that serve as keys to the identities of figures in group portraits exhibited in those years. The 2 prints for 1814 and single print for 1820 are etched, the 2 for 1846 are lithographed by Hullmandel & Walton
Getty c. 1 annotated with year of exhibition at head of each page. Lists of contributors supplied in MS for most years that lack a printed list
Second copies of the catalogs for 1814, 1830 and 1833 are bound with: A catalogue of the pictures, sculptures, designs in architecture ... / Society of Artists of Great Britain. London : W. Bunce, 1765 (83-B3439)

Subjects: Painting, British; Painting, European
